paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Sechora before Rav Hamnuna: Chullin 107b; Rabbah, end of Bekhorot. He explained it at the festival lecture—the Sabbath before the festival—before Rava …. Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said, “Happy is his mother,” for she merited bearing a son like him: Bekhorot 60a.
